Thanks for the context, Lukas. Quick legal guidance and suggested language below.

SOC 2: We are happy to share the SOC 2 Type II report under our standard mutual NDA; however, to reduce friction we can first provide an assertion map that maps SOC 2 controls to the HealthSync scope. If HealthSyncs procurement insists on the full report prior to signature, well request a redline to the Order Form to allow delivery subject to an executed NDA (clause to be proposed).

Pen test / RoE: Acceptable to propose 30-day notice for tests on production-equivalent environments; we must insist on:
- Clear scoping (IP ranges, target lists) and pre-authorized personnel.
- A standard limitation of liability carveout for negligence during authorized testing, and a requirement to pause testing if a critical service degradation is observed.
- A short post-test remediation coordination window (14 days) and a requirement that the customer coordinates public disclosure through Redwoods security team.

Evidence cadence: Recommend we propose a standard quarterly package plus a named contact list for ad-hoc requests. SLA for evidence retrieval will be 72 hours for normal requests and 7 days for requests requiring manual artifacts (subject to reasonable scope).

Ive attached a one-page MAP template you can use to capture owners, cadence, dates, and the chosen pen-test week. Also attached are suggested redline snippets for the Order Form and a sample RoE.

Next steps:
- Lukas: send the MAP and the suggested candidate test dates to HealthSync and ask whether they prefer the report under NDA or the map first.
- Karthik/Vanessa: help finalize the redline snippets in the orderform-draft-v3.docx (Ill insert the NDA clause if they want the full SOC 2).

Laura Bennett
